Y llegamos al algoritmo que entrena hoy: And we come to the algorithm that today trains almost everything. Its idea is that each parameter needs a different step: if one input is measured in millimetres and another in kilometres, their gradients have incomparable sizes and a single learning rate cannot serve both. To fix that you need to know “what size the gradient of each parameter usually is”, and that is exactly what [[cib-filtrado|an exponential moving average]] measures.
